items.title: Zeroday Cloud hacking event awards $320,0000 for 11 zero days
items.description: The Zeroday Cloud hacking competition in London has awarded researchers $320,000 for demonstrating critical remote code execution vulnerabilities in components used in cloud infrastructure. [...]

items.title: Critical Fortinet Flaws Under Active Attack
items.description: Attackers are targeting admin accounts, and once authenticated, exporting device configurations including hashed credentials and other sensitive information.

items.title: France arrests suspect tied to cyberattack on Interior Ministry
items.description: French authorities arrested a 22-year-old suspect on Tuesday for a cyberattack that targeted France's Ministry of the Interior earlier this month. [...]

items.title: In Cybersecurity, Claude Leaves Other LLMs in the Dust
items.description: Anthropic proves that LLMs can be fairly resistant to abuse. Most developers are either incapable of building safer tools, or unwilling to invest in doing so.

items.title: Amazon: Ongoing cryptomining campaign uses hacked AWS accounts
items.description: Amazon's AWS GuardDuty security team is warning of an ongoing crypto-mining campaign that targets its Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) and Elastic Container Service (ECS) using compromised credentials for Identity and Access Management (IAM). [...]

items.title: 'Cellik' Android RAT Leverages Google Play Store
items.description: The remote access Trojan lets an attacker remotely control a victim's phone and can generate malicious apps from inside the Play Store.
